title: Faith doesn’t eliminate fear.
paragraphs: Faith doesn’t eliminate fear.
It teaches your trembling hands to still obey God.
Psalm 56:3 says, “When I am afraid, I put my trust in you.”
Not if I am afraid.
When.
God saw it.

The shaking.
The overthinking.
The silent panic behind your smile.
The prayers you whispered with a heart still racing.
You thought fear meant your faith was weak.
But here’s what most people don’t realize…

Faith is not the absence of fear.
Faith is trusting God while fear is screaming.
You knew.

You knew God was calling you to step forward.
To forgive.
To surrender.
To stop hiding.
To obey even without guarantees.
And fear said, “What if you fall?”
But grace answered, “Even there, Jesus holds you.”

The cross proves this:
Your courage is not rooted in your strength.
Your salvation is not earned by fearless performance.
You are saved by grace through faith in Jesus Christ.
So move.

Afraid—but trusting.
Weak—but held.
Shaking—but surrendered.
Because the same God who sees your fear also commands your future.
“When I am afraid, I put my trust in you.” — Psalm 56:3
Read that again.
Originally written by Gospel Warrior
